record.question: SCO, TEF, UGH, _______, WKL
record.explanation: Official final key: B — VIJ. MPSC notification 9 March 2026, Group B non-gazetted technical H&FW examination held 29 January–2 February 2026; key physical page 5, printed Q89. Source limitation: Original source genuinely prints SCO (letter O), not SCD. VIJ follows the familiar SCD/TEF/UGH pattern only after altering the printed first term; preserve and explicitly review that correction first. The final key establishes the historical marking choice without removing that limitation.
